bpmn20Xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" xmlns:modeler="http://camunda.org/schema/modeler/1.0" id="Definitions_PrintLabel" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" modeler:executionPlatform="Camunda Platform" modeler:executionPlatformVersion="7.24.0">
  <bpmn:process id="pulse-label" name="Print label" isExecutable="true" camunda:historyTimeToLive="180">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_LabelRequested" name="Label requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelRequestedToRenderLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Activity_RenderLabel" name="Render label" camunda:asyncBefore="true" camunda:expression="${labelPrinter.print(orderId)}">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelRequestedToRenderLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RenderLabelToLabelPrinted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_LabelPrinted" name="Label printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RenderLabelToLabelPrinted</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RenderLabelToLabelPrinted" sourceRef="Activity_RenderLabel" targetRef="Event_LabelPrinted" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelRequestedToRenderLabel" sourceRef="Event_LabelRequested" targetRef="Activity_RenderLabel" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_pulse-label">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_pulse-label" bpmnElement="pulse-label">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_Event_LabelRequested" bpmnElement="Event_LabelRequested">
        <dc:Bounds x="80" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="61" y="144" width="75" height="28" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_Activity_RenderLabel" bpmnElement="Activity_RenderLabel">
        <dc:Bounds x="176" y="80" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_Event_LabelPrinted" bpmnElement="Event_LabelPrinted">
        <dc:Bounds x="336" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="324" y="144" width="61" height="28" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="BPMNEdge_Flow_RenderLabelToLabelPrinted" bpmnElement="Flow_RenderLabelToLabelPrinted">
        <di:waypoint x="276" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="336" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="BPMNEdge_Flow_LabelRequestedToRenderLabel" bpmnElement="Flow_LabelRequestedToRenderLabel">
        <di:waypoint x="116" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="176" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
